comparison: Strong agreement on cryo-EM structural data quality and findings about αK40 loops and MIP interactions (C39-C44, C48-C52, C82-C83). Both evaluations find the evidence compelling and well-supported. OpenEval provides detailed structural analysis while peer reviewers praise 'excellent data quality' and 'depth of analysis.'

OpenEval separately evaluates claims C45-C47 about αK40 loop conformations and lateral interactions as supported. Peer review includes these claims in their broader positive assessment of the structural findings without specific concerns.

Strong agreement on acetylation mutant findings (C54-C56, C85-C87). Both find the cryo-EM data showing intact MIP decoration compelling. OpenEval notes the inference about post-assembly acetylation is logical; peer reviewers have no concerns about these findings.

Strong agreement on inter-PF angle measurements (C58-C61, C64, C108). Both evaluations recognize this as a significant finding with compelling evidence. Peer reviewers explicitly identify this as demonstrating acetylation's impact on doublet microtubule structure and stability.

OpenEval evaluates structural measurement claims (C57, C62-C63) as supported with appropriate acknowledgment of resolution limitations. Peer review R2 includes C62-C63 in their positive assessment of the inter-PF angle findings without raising concerns about limitations.
OpenEval addresses resolution limitations (C57) as appropriately acknowledged. Peer review R3 includes C57 in their general praise of data quality without specific concerns about resolution issues.

Both address primary conclusion C5 about inter-PF angle effects. OpenEval finds it well-supported by experimental data; peer reviewers identify it as 'compelling evidence' and a 'significant finding.'

Perfect agreement on molecular dynamics simulation findings (C65-C66, C81). Both evaluations support the clustering analysis showing conformational differences. Peer reviewers praise the 'robust combination' of methods including molecular dynamics.

Perfect agreement on coarse-grained MD simulations (C67-C69). Both find the minimal energy difference findings supported. Peer reviewers commend the multi-disciplinary approach without raising concerns about these simulations.

Strong agreement on mass spectrometry findings about acetylation-phosphorylation relationship (C70-C75, C79-C80, C98). Both find the data well-supported. Peer reviewers note the study 'contributes to broader understanding' though 'details remain elusive,' while OpenEval finds the quantitative data and controls strengthen the analysis.

Both address primary conclusion C6 about acetylation-phosphorylation relationship. OpenEval finds it well-supported by mass spectrometry; peer reviewers acknowledge the contribution while noting details remain elusive.

Strong agreement on the main interpretive model (C88-C90, C94). Both evaluations find the integration of multiple evidence lines compelling. OpenEval emphasizes logical synthesis of findings; peer reviewers praise 'valuable insights' and 'compelling evidence' about structure-stability effects.

OpenEval rates claims C95-C102 as uncertain, mixing supported observations with speculation about mechanisms. Peer review R7 includes C95 in their positive assessment of the model without distinguishing speculative elements, having 'no major concerns.'

Divergence in evaluation. OpenEval rates claims C103-C112 about polymodification and PTM crosstalk as uncertain, noting significant speculation and indirect connections requiring validation. Peer reviewers praise the comprehensive analysis and contributions to understanding PTMs with 'no major concerns,' not distinguishing speculative elements.

OpenEval identifies claims C91-C93 about functional significance in the tip region as uncertain speculation requiring experimental testing. No corresponding peer review evaluation found addressing these specific claims.
OpenEval evaluates background/context claims C1-C38 as supported by established literature. No corresponding peer review evaluation found specifically addressing these background claims.
